crossRefs.note: Yahweh delivered to me the two stone tablets written with God’s finger. On them were all the words which Yahweh spoke…
and you said, “Behold, Yahweh our God has shown us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the…
They said to Moses, “Speak with us yourself, and we will listen; but don’t let God speak with us, lest we die.”
the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which those who heard it begged that not one more word should be spoken…

people.name: Sinai
people.line: Mountain where Moses received the Ten Commandments

translations.web: This is according to all that you desired of Yahweh your God in Horeb in the day of the assembly, saying, “Let me not hear again Yahweh my God’s voice, neither let me see this great fire any more, that I not die.”
translations.bsb: This is what you asked of the LORD your God at Horeb on the day of the assembly, when you said, “Let us not hear the voice of the LORD our God or see this great fire anymore, so that we will not die!”
translations.kjv: According to all that thou desiredst of the LORD thy God in Horeb in the day of the assembly, saying, Let me not hear again the voice of the LORD my God, neither let me see this great fire any more, that I die
translations.asv: according to all that thou desiredst of Jehovah thy God in Horeb in the day of the assembly, saying, Let me not hear again the voice of Jehovah my God, neither let me see this great fire any more, that I die not.
